name: Damian Martinelli
description: **Software engineer & technical leader** building web products since 1996. Start-up founder and CTO in the past, he has been working as a blockchain engineer at **BuidlGuidl** (A curated group of Ethereum builders creating products, prototypes, and tutorials to enrich the Web3 ecosystem) since 2022. He is also a data science teacher at the **University of Buenos Aires**.
